caption: The drawing features two dresses depicted on a plain, light beige background. Both dresses appear empty with no visible bodies wearing them. The dress on the left is rendered solely in fine pencil lines, showing an outline and internal draping with vertical stripes, overall giving the appearance of a sketch or preliminary study. The dress on the right is more detailed and occupies the right half of the paper. It is a full-length, long-sleeved gown shown in beige or off-white, with prominent blue vertical stripes running throughout the fabric. The dress has a fitted bodice with diagonal striping and a wide neckline, along with gathered or puffed sleeves ending at the wrists. The skirt of this dress is long, full, and gathered at the waist. Both dresses are depicted frontally and occupy the upper half of the drawing. The majority of the background is left blank, focusing attention on the garments.
title: Cream Taffeta Dress
